# The Tech Wolves

> A remote-first AI automation and software engineering studio that ships custom software, AI agents, and automation systems for SMEs, startups, and scale-ups across healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, EdTech, real estate, logistics, and travel.

The Tech Wolves provides production AI automation, custom web/mobile applications, UI/UX design, business process automation, and digital transformation consulting. Founded 2020. Global remote-first team. Engagements range from prototypes to multi-quarter platform builds.

## What we do

- AI automation: LLM integration (Claude, GPT-5, Gemini), agent design, workflow automation with n8n / custom orchestration, retrieval pipelines.
- Custom software: Next.js / React / Node / Python / Go web apps, cross-platform mobile (Flutter / React Native), backend infra on Vercel / GCP / Supabase.
- Process automation: CRM workflows, ERP integrations, IoT dashboards, internal tooling.
- UI/UX: design systems, prototyping, conversion-tuned landing pages.
- Digital transformation consulting: roadmaps, build-vs-buy analysis, vendor selection.

## Pricing tiers (starting points — every quote tailored)

- **Basic** — startup launch (custom site, branding, hosting, basic SEO, 3-month support).
- **Pro** — growth stage (everything in Basic + brand identity, social setup, advanced SEO, 6-month support).
- **Premium** — scale-up (everything in Pro + e-commerce, CRM, digital marketing, 12-month priority support, performance dashboard).

## Industries served

Healthcare (HIPAA-grade telemedicine, EHR integrations) · FinTech (banking apps, payments, compliance) · E-commerce (B2C and B2B platforms) · EdTech (e-learning, virtual classrooms) · Real estate (listings, virtual tours, CRM) · Logistics (real-time tracking, inventory) · Travel (booking, itinerary planning) · Manufacturing (ERP, IoT, analytics).
